question: Through which of the following actions does the lithosphere move over the asthenosphere?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plate Tectonics**__.

__
 
• Due to plate tectonics, the lithosphere move over the asthenosphere.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **lithosphere** is the** rocky outer part **of the** Earth**.
 
• It is made up of the** brittle crust **and the top part of the** upper mantle.**
